decisive_items: Few, micro-ischemic focal lesions in the periventricular and deep white matter of the cerebral hemispheres
The patient's main difficulties were noted on his left side
response.rationale: Cognitive impairment with focal left-sided symptoms and MRI evidence of micro-ischemic white-matter lesions best fits vascular dementia; depressive and anxiety symptoms are comorbid, while NPH lacks ventriculomegaly/triad and small vessel disease is an imaging substrate rather than the clinical syndrome.

rejected.why: No ventriculomegaly or gait/urinary triad; partially empty sella is nonspecific.
Depression is explicitly comorbid and does not explain focal left-sided findings or MRI ischemic lesions.
Anxiety is comorbid and insufficient as the primary cause of cognitive and focal motor symptoms.
Small vessel disease is the imaging substrate, but with cognitive decline and focal symptoms vascular dementia is the appropriate clinical diagnosis.
